verify.note: same sim as the published number

summary: Fury Dual Wield keeping Battle Shout up for its party, with the raid's Battle Shout off. 3.9 DPS behind the base build at 180s.
rotation: Start in Berserker Stance with no Rage; Bloodrage and Battle Shout 3s before the pull
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
Battle Shout again with 35s of it left (about 142s in, before the execute phase), unless it lasts the fight (Forever's lasts 3 min)
Death Wish right after the Sunder, Recklessness one GCD later
Racial cooldowns with Death Wish (Blood Fury and Berserking also at the end of the fight); trinket on cooldown; Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20s
Execute first in the execute phase
Heroic Strike queued from 50 Rage (outside execute)
Hamstring filler from 10 Rage (procs Windfury Totem and Flurry)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 30 Strength and 16 crit rating, and an on-use 335 attack power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).

White hit Rage is normalized to the weapon: k × swing speed (k is 3.46 one-hand and 4.5 two-hand, measured at level 30). It grows with level to ×1.5 at 60, the same for the off hand. Not yet measured at 60.
Synthetic Phase 1 gear on Forever's physical budget (ids 991001-991018)
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit (client data). Each crit restarting the Deep Wounds tick timer is our modeling choice.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike swings count for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir per character, since it's unknown if Ferocity stacks with Mongoose. A second one (Grizzly) would add 15.1.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece (+36 AP vs Humanoids) not counted. It would add 10.8 at 180s.
Second Mighty Rage Potion held for the last 20s: +6.4 at 180s, -3.0 at 120s.
Bloodthirst sometimes slips a GCD for lack of Rage. Holding fillers for it loses DPS.
Raid damage hits on the warrior (2 a minute at 1500 damage, about 15 Rage each) are estimated from boss timers. The assumptions panel also runs 0 and 10 a minute.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_fury -apl level60_fury_battle_shout -talents 30305013002-25053005122010501-2 -race Orc -duration 180, then the raid's battleShout removed (standards 23: the duty preset's own shout is the only one). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts.
